pages.title: Supper, Anyone?
pages.text: A bowl and brush turn the first accepted feeding into a usable care corner, with a small kibble reserve for later visits.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Hamsters take Sunflower Seeds; Manx Cats and Great Pyrenees accept Pet Kibble. Credit requires accepted feeding with real food consumption or healing, never a failed click.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Harvest Sunflower Seeds and return after morning regrowth. The flower follows the sun and renews seeds for Hamster taming.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use pet kibble on Manx Cats or Great Pyrenees. The native tooltip identifies kibble as pet healing food.
